lines.text: Many learners say: Five persons came to the party.
Better: Five people came to the party.
In everyday English, we say people.
People! There are four people in my family.

data.wrong: Five persons came to the party.
data.right: Five people came to the party.
data.why: In everyday English, we say people.

quiz.stem: There are four ___ in my family.

native.tip: نقول «خمسة أشخاص»، لكن persons رسمية جدًا، فنقول people: “Five people came to the party.” وليس “Five persons came to the party.”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا هذه الجملة؟ “Five persons came to the party.” 😅 نقول «خمسة أشخاص»، وكلمة persons رسمية جدًا، أما في الكلام اليومي فنقول five people، فالجملة الصحيحة “Five people came to the party.” استمع إلى Ama وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.

en.tip: In Arabic we say «خمسة أشخاص», but persons is very formal, and in everyday English we say five people: “Five people came to the party.” not “Five persons came to the party.”
en.caption: Do you sometimes say this? “Five persons came to the party.” 😅 In Arabic we say «خمسة أشخاص», but persons is very formal, and in everyday English we say five people, so the right sentence is “Five people came to the party.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
